page.layout: One page of text: running head above, page number at top right, the body set in one column with displayed arithmetic examples between the paragraphs. No margin notes, no notes below the text.

p.i: Aliud exemplum, in quo Fractiones primùm colliguntur: Deinde multi-plicantur.

main_text.head: De divisione Fractionum.
main_text.p: In Divisione Fractionum superior fini-stra nota per inferiorem dextram, & supe-rior dextra per inferiorem finistram multi-plicatur: Deinde fit Divisio.
main_text.head: De Regula Detri in Fractionibus.

page.notes: The fractions in the arithmetic displays are small and tightly set; their exact numerators and denominators are uncertain and are marked [?]. The first example line "5 5 9" and "3 2" are copied as printed with spacing approximated. The "Aliud exemplum" caption and the "Aliud." labels are italic lines, not headings. The large initial R of "Regula" is read as the ordinary letter R. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot of the page. The page number is printed as "397" at top right.
